elements.name: TextBox 146
elements.text: REED-AI advances trustworthy AI methods and deployment frameworks for healthcare. We invite original research, position papers, and case studies on transparent, robust, accountable, safe, and ethically aligned clinical AI. The track emphasizes real-world translation, including generalizability, reliability, clinician trust, workflow integration, regulatory readiness, and societal impact, and connects researchers, clinicians, industry, policymakers, and regulators.
